name: Delivery timeline
description: Scheduled work on one timeline, with what is still ahead.
long_description:
Puts every dated task in the initiative on a shared timeline, grouped into lanes, with the open count beside it, a running total of finished work week by week, and the full list below.

Tasks with no start or due date do not appear on the timeline — they are still counted, and still listed.
release_notes: Adds Finished so far: a running total of finished work, week by week, under the figures.

binding.sql: SELECT title, tasks.start_date AS start_date, due_date FROM tasks WHERE tasks.start_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false ORDER BY tasks.start_date
SELECT count(*) AS tasks FROM tasks WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false
SELECT count(*) AS overdue FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND due_date < now() AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false
SELECT count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at >= now() - CAST('30 days' AS interval) AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false
SELECT count(tasks.completed_at) AS finished, count(*) AS total FROM tasks WHERE tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false

SELECT date_trunc('week', completed_at) AS week, sum(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('week', completed_at)) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT title, tasks.start_date AS start_date, due_date, priority FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false ORDER BY due_date
